final: WITH by_code AS (SELECT positionText AS code, SUM(CAST(laps AS INTEGER)) AS lap_sum FROM results GROUP BY positionText), total AS (SELECT SUM(lap_sum) AS total_laps FROM by_code), divisions AS (SELECT b.code, b.lap_sum, b.lap_sum * 1.0 / t.total_laps AS division FROM by_code AS b JOIN total AS t ON t.total_laps IS NOT NULL), average AS (SELECT AVG(division) AS avg_division FROM divisions), kept AS (SELECT d.code, d.lap_sum, d.division, d.division - a.avg_division AS difference FROM divisions AS d JOIN average AS a ON a.avg_division IS NOT NULL WHERE d.division > a.avg_division) SELECT SUM(lap_sum) AS total_lap_sums, AVG(division) AS average_division, AVG(difference) AS average_difference FROM kept.
